gemfan_5045_hbn.source_note: Oscar Liang EMAX RS2205S motor thrust-test article. Table uses the label 'Gemfan 5045 HBN' for the propeller tested at 100% throttle (1375g thrust, 30.3A, 485.3W — matches this catalog's own emax_rs2205s_2300 operating_points entry for propeller_sku gemfan_5045_hbn). The article states only thrust/current/power test results; it does NOT state mass, hub diameter/thickness, blade count, or material for the propeller itself. 'HBN' does not appear as an official model code on any Gemfan/retailer page found (searched 2026-09-09) — physical dims beyond diameter_in/pitch_in remain UNKNOWN, not inferred from a similarly-named 'Bullnose' retail variant.

dal_7040.source_note: DALProp Cyclone 7040, 7in/pitch 4, 2-blade, Pure PC (polycarbonate). Diameter of Hub: 5mm, Height of Hub: 7mm. Weight 5.7g. POPO: Support. Sold as a 2CW+2CCW pack. GetFPV's own listing (the SoT URL above) returned a Cloudflare bot-challenge page (HTTP 403) on every re-fetch attempt 2026-09-09 — these figures were cross-verified live against two independent resellers carrying the identical DALProp spec sheet (unmannedtechshop.co.uk and pyrodrone.com, both quoting 5.7g / hub 5mm-7mm / Pure PC / POPO Support verbatim, matching each other exactly). No shaft bore distinct from hub Ø stated on any page checked.

apc_10x6_ep.source_note: APC 10x6EP, 10in/pitch 6, 2-blade 'Thin Electric Pusher' composite plastic, CW (gray). Weight 20.1g, Hub Diameter 20.3mm, Hub Thickness 9.9mm, Shaft Bore 6.35mm. GetFPV's own listing (the SoT URL above) returned a Cloudflare bot-challenge page (HTTP 403) on every re-fetch attempt 2026-09-09 — these figures were cross-verified live against racedayquads.com's identical listing (20.1g / 20.3mm / 9.9mm / 6.35mm / Composite plastic / CW, verbatim) AND against APC's own manufacturer page (apcprop.com/product/10x6ep: 0.71 oz / 0.80 in hub dia / 0.39 in hub thickness / 1/4 in shaft bore — converts exactly to 20.13g / 20.32mm / 9.91mm / 6.35mm). This is a distinct SKU from apc_10x4_5 (10x4.5, no mass seeded) — not an overwrite, not a merge.

tmotor_22x6_7.source_note: Identity debt: the current T-Motor propeller catalog lists a 'P22x6.6' entry, not 'P22x6.7'. This row's SKU key and pitch_in (6.7) are NOT renamed/corrected this Buy — no mass or other bag field seeded pending that identity resolution.

gf_5045x3.source_note: EMAX shop listing ('★2 Pairs 5045 3 Blade Propeller ABS CW-CCW For Mini Quadcopter', page's own Product Code 0106003102 — re-fetched 2026-09-09). Page states: Material ABS, 3 blades, weight 4.5 grams per prop, hub diameter 5mm, hub thickness 9.5mm, diameter 5in, pitch 4.5in, pack contents 2xCW and 2xCCW (1 full set per pack). Page does not state a weight tolerance or a shaft bore/hole diameter distinct from the hub — both omitted, not invented.
